title: Planum
description:
Planum is an open 3D atlas of the human brain, where cortical and deep parcellations, tractography and the published findings for each region are read on the same anatomy. It is built from real MRI data, with the surface, the sections and the white-matter tracts all taken from the same brain, so they agree with one another. Widely used cortical parcellations and a histological atlas of the deep structures are drawn on that anatomy. Selecting a region brings up what has been reported about it in meta-analyses of the imaging literature, lesion studies, intracranial stimulation and large group comparisons, each with its source. A coordinate or a statistical map from a study can be placed on the brain to see where it falls, and a standard MNI template can be used as the anatomy instead. The live atlas is at planumatlas.com.

Licence scope. The AGPL-3.0-or-later licence of this record covers the source code of the build pipeline and the web viewer only. The neuroimaging data and the assets derived from it (everything under data/, public/models/ and public/diffusion/) stay under the terms of their origin, some of which are non-commercial or require an acknowledgement. NOTICE lists those terms, docs/reference/references.md gives each source and the acknowledgement it requires, and public/models/licenses/ holds the licence texts shipped with the data.

Planum is for research and education. It is not a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment or any other clinical decision.
